quests.desc: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, look and see that the type U chest is unlocked. And then, ensure that the type U chest inside the study is open. After that, pick up the passkey from the type U chest within the study. Having taken the passkey, make absolutely sure that the safe within the study is unlocked with the passkey. And then, open the safe. And then, take the key from the safe within the study. Having taken the key, head east. Next, unlock the locker inside the canteen with the key. After that, make it so that the locker is ajar. After that, take the type T key from the locker in the canteen. Then, make an effort to venture west. Okay, and then, make sure that the type T hatch is unlocked. After unlocking the type T hatch, ensure that the type T hatch within the study is open. And if you do that, you're the winner!

objective: Welcome to another fast paced round of TextWorld! First of all, you could, like, unlock the type U chest with the type U latchkey. And then, ensure that the type U chest is open. And then, recover the passkey from the type U chest inside the study. Then, doublecheck that the safe is unlocked. After unlocking the safe, open the safe in the study. And then, retrieve the key from the safe. After that, go east. Then, unlock the locker in the canteen with the key. After that, open the locker. And then, recover the type T key from the locker in the canteen. If you can get your hands on the type T key, take a trip west. And then, insert the type T key into the type T hatch in the study's lock to unlock it. After that, open the type T hatch in the study. And once you've done that, you win!
